42192906.exclusion_reason: broad cross-cancer AI translational-readiness review covering 18 malignancies, mostly adult (breast, prostate, lung, colorectal, etc.); pediatric solid tumors are one brief subsection, not the focus, and the review is not primarily about imaging

42194210.exclusion_reason: AI (LLM) analyzes 3D-scanned/photographed physical objects (aspirated foreign bodies) and their morphometric descriptors, not patient radiologic images; airway CT/radiograph dimensions are used only as normative reference context

42196791.clinical_problem: Characterizing structural brain abnormalities (corpus callosum, white matter signal, ventriculomegaly) in children with autism using an AI-assisted MRI platform
42196791.model_description: CE-certified AI platform (mdbrain) used to analyze structural brain MRI and classify findings into corpus callosum anomalies, white matter signal abnormalities, ventriculomegaly, other abnormalities, or no detectable changes in children with ASD.
42196791.headline_result: White matter signal abnormalities in 23.3% of patients; reduced total white matter volume was the only independent predictor of pathological findings
42196791.study_design: retrospective cross-sectional study using a commercial AI platform

42207158.clinical_problem: Automated multidimensional classification of prenatal ultrasound report findings to support phenotype-genotype correlation
42207158.patient_population: 254 reports with fetal anomalies drawn from a cohort of 4,256 pregnancies
42207158.model_description: LLM framework (DeepSeek-V3.2 base and chain-of-thought reasoning variants) with retrieval-augmented generation, applied to free-text prenatal ultrasound reports to classify anomaly type, standardized terminology, anatomical system, count, and severity.
42207158.dataset_size: 254 reports with fetal anomalies from 4,256 pregnancies
42207158.headline_result: Base model >90% accuracy/F1 on factual tasks; reasoning model 86% accuracy/F1=0.75 on external severity grading without RAG
42207158.study_design: retrospective comparative study of LLM framework variants

42207257.clinical_problem: Reducing breath-hold burden and scan time in pediatric and young-adult cardiac cine MRI while maintaining diagnostic quality
42207257.patient_population: 25 patients with pectus excavatum and 15 with cardiomyopathy (children and young adults)
42207257.model_description: Commercially available deep learning-accelerated cine bSSFP MRI reconstruction (SonicDL) evaluated across breath-hold and free-breathing acquisition configurations, with automated DL-based ventricular segmentation for volumetric comparison.
42207257.headline_result: Scan time reduced 57% (4-RR breath-hold) to 87% (1-RR free-breathing); volumetric biases <2 mL/m2, limits of agreement ~±6 mL/m2

42207261.clinical_problem: Reducing radiation dose in pediatric cardiac CT while maintaining image quality using super-resolution deep learning reconstruction
42207261.patient_population: Phantom study plus 9 conventional-DLR and 11 SR-DLR pediatric clinical cardiac CT images
42207261.model_description: Super-resolution deep learning reconstruction (SR-DLR) algorithm compared with conventional deep learning reconstruction (C-DLR) for pediatric cardiac CT, assessed with phantom and clinical image quality metrics at reduced radiation dose.
42207261.dataset_size: phantom study + 9 C-DLR and 11 SR-DLR pediatric clinical exams
42207261.headline_result: SR-DLR at 250 mA matched C-DLR at 800 mA noise while improving spatial resolution; clinical dose 4.25±0.54 vs. 13.3±6.43 mGy with non-inferior quality
42207261.study_design: phantom and retrospective clinical comparative study

42209472.exclusion_reason: adult cohort (German National Cohort, NAKO, 26,378 adults); not pediatric

42211411.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (panoramic radiograph dental age estimation); excluded non-radiologic imaging modality

42216968.clinical_problem: Reviewing quantitative MRI biomarkers, including AI/ML-assisted analysis, for non-invasive assessment of pediatric chronic kidney disease and renal fibrosis
42216968.model_description: Narrative review of quantitative MRI techniques (T1/T2/T2* mapping, diffusion-weighted imaging, magnetization transfer, elastography) and emerging AI/machine learning analysis methods for evaluating renal fibrosis in pediatric chronic kidney disease; no single model.

42221080.exclusion_reason: adult gynecological condition (adenomyosis, affecting women of childbearing age); not pediatric

42222137.clinical_problem: Reducing radiation dose while improving image quality in pediatric contrast-enhanced abdominal CT using a deep learning iterative reconstruction algorithm
42222137.patient_population: 100 pediatric patients undergoing contrast-enhanced abdominal CT
42222137.model_description: Deep learning full-model iterative reconstruction algorithm (AIIR) applied to low-kVp, higher-mAs pediatric abdominal CT protocols and compared with hybrid iterative reconstruction for noise, SNR/CNR, and radiation dose.
42222137.headline_result: Effective dose reduced 23.61% (p<0.001); higher SNR/CNR for liver, spleen, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas, aorta (all p<0.05)

42223485.model_family: ensemble ML (random forest + gradient boosting) and ResNet101V2 deep learning
42223485.clinical_problem: Classifying pediatric posterior fossa tumor type (medulloblastoma, pilocytic astrocytoma, ependymoma, diffuse midline glioma) from MRI
42223485.patient_population: 63 pediatric patients with confirmed posterior fossa tumors
42223485.model_description: Machine learning (gradient boosting, decision tree, random forest ensembles) and a ResNet101V2-based deep learning model, both using MRI-derived radiomic features/sequences, to classify pediatric posterior fossa tumor subtype.
42223485.headline_result: RF+GBM ensemble 78% accuracy (ML); DL model 98% (T1WI) and 96% (contrast-enhanced T1WI) accuracy

42224791.clinical_problem: Stratifying pediatric myocarditis patients using radiomic signatures from late gadolinium enhancement cardiac MRI
42224791.patient_population: 195 pediatric patients with confirmed myocarditis, median age 16
42224791.model_description: Radiomic features extracted from spatially resolved LGE cardiac MRI, decomposed via non-negative matrix factorization into distinct signatures correlated with clinical characteristics; a software tool applies the method to new patients.
42224791.headline_result: NMF identified 4 patient groups; correlation with left-ventricular ejection fraction r=-0.38, log(NT-proBNP) r=0.36

42226141.clinical_problem: Improving image quality and diagnostic confidence for PRETEXT staging of pediatric hepatoblastoma using dual-energy CT with deep learning reconstruction
42226141.patient_population: 53 pediatric patients with pathologically confirmed hepatoblastoma, mean age 3.54±2.26 years
42226141.model_description: Thin-slice (0.625 mm) low-energy (40 keV) virtual monochromatic dual-energy CT images combined with high-level deep learning image reconstruction (DLIR-H), compared with standard-energy/ASIR-V reconstructions for PRETEXT staging.
42226141.headline_result: 40 keV DLIR-H best edge rise slope (83.73±46.50, p<0.001) and highest subjective diagnostic confidence scores (p<0.001)

42229420.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation of the amygdala on structural MRI, addressing challenges specific to pediatric neuroimaging
42229420.patient_population: Children and adolescents from large-scale developmental neuroimaging studies
42229420.model_description: Boundary-aware deep learning model integrating multiscale feature extraction, spatial priors, and self-attention within a compact encoder-decoder to segment the amygdala, trained and validated on manually labeled pediatric MRI scans.
42229420.study_design: methods development and multi-dataset validation study

42230409.clinical_problem: Predicting seizure recurrence after resection of pediatric low-grade epilepsy-associated brain tumors using multi-sequence MRI radiomics and clinical features
42230409.patient_population: Pediatric patients with low-grade epilepsy-associated tumors undergoing gross total resection
42230409.model_description: Multisequence MRI radiomics models (traditional and deep-learning-derived) combined with clinical features (including epilepsy duration) to predict postoperative seizure recurrence in pediatric low-grade epilepsy-associated tumors.

42231359.exclusion_reason: review of pediatric ultrasound elastography applications; AI is mentioned only in passing as a future direction, not the focus

42231814.exclusion_reason: epidemiological trends study of cleft palate incidence, prenatal detection rates, and abortion rates; no AI/ML component

42231960.clinical_problem: Estimating brain age from cortical MRI features to detect neurodevelopmental/cognitive delay in children with beta-thalassemia major
42231960.patient_population: 25 children with beta-thalassemia major and 40 age/sex-matched healthy controls, ages 6-15
42231960.model_description: Surface-based graph neural network (SurfGNN) that estimates brain age from cortical morphological features extracted via structural MRI; the brain-age index is compared with cognitive and hematological measures.
42231960.headline_result: Beta-thalassemia children showed significantly lower cognitive scores and delayed brain age (lower brain-age index) than controls; BAI correlated with hemoglobin/ferritin levels

42232195.clinical_problem: Narrative review of early fetal echocardiography, including AI-based image analysis, for early detection of congenital heart disease
42232195.patient_population: Fetuses at risk for congenital heart disease
42232195.model_description: Narrative review of early (11-14 week) fetal echocardiography for detecting congenital heart disease, describing emerging AI applications that enhance image analysis and diagnostic accuracy; no single model.

42232684.exclusion_reason: randomized controlled trial of electroacupuncture for adult knee osteoarthritis; AI-based MRI measures are an exploratory secondary outcome, and the population is adult, matching the explicit adult knee osteoarthritis exclusion example

42233988.model_name: Stanford, CCHMC, and MedImageInsight bone age models
42233988.clinical_problem: Evaluating agreement of three deep learning bone age estimation models with chronological age, including bias by demographic subgroup
42233988.patient_population: 7,189 children (3,669 female, 3,520 male), ages 24-216 months, with radiologically normal hand radiographs obtained for trauma
42233988.model_description: Three previously developed deep learning bone age models (Stanford, CCHMC, MedImageInsight) applied to hand radiographs to estimate Greulich-and-Pyle-based bone age, compared against chronological age and assessed for bias by sex, race, and ethnicity.
42233988.headline_result: All models overestimated chronological age; mean bias CCHMC +3.20 months, MedImageInsight +4.60 months, Stanford +7.03 months (all p<0.0001)

42235268.model_family: self-supervised pretraining (masked image modeling + contrastive learning) with model ensemble
42235268.clinical_problem: Improving cross-device/cross-site generalization of AI models for pediatric wrist fracture assessment on point-of-care ultrasound
42235268.model_description: Target-informed self-supervised pretraining (masked image modeling and contrastive learning) with a confidence-aware infusion head, enabling bony-structure segmentation models trained on one ultrasound probe to generalize to an unlabeled dataset from a different probe/site.
42235268.headline_result: >6% Dice improvement on the target domain versus baseline

42236425.clinical_problem: Detecting ventriculomegaly on prenatal ultrasound using an ultrasound-specific foundation model
42236425.patient_population: Curated fetal brain ultrasound dataset, fine-tuned from a foundation model pretrained on the OpenUS-46 corpus
42236425.model_description: Vision transformer-based ultrasound self-supervised foundation model (USF-MAE), pretrained via masked autoencoding on >370,000 ultrasound images, fine-tuned to classify fetal brain ultrasound images as normal or ventriculomegaly.
42236425.dataset_size: pretrained on >370,000 ultrasound images (OpenUS-46 corpus); fine-tuned/tested on a curated fetal brain dataset
42236425.study_design: retrospective model development study with 5-fold cross-validation and independent test cohort

42238395.clinical_problem: Predicting later adolescent substance use and psychotic-like experiences from childhood neuroimaging, demographic, and clinical measures
42238395.patient_population: 10,134 participants from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, baseline mean age 9.96 years
42238395.model_description: Multivariate machine learning models using childhood structural and functional neuroimaging measures (connectivity, task-related activation), demographic, and clinical factors to predict later adolescent substance use and/or psychotic-like experiences.
42238395.headline_result: AUROC 0.780 (psychotic-like experiences), 0.828 (co-occurrence with substance use), 0.626 (substance use alone)
42238395.study_design: longitudinal cohort study with machine learning prediction (preprint)

42241733.model_family: multimodal deep learning (ResNet, HRNet, ResNet-LSTM, Transformer, GNN, random forest ensemble)
42241733.clinical_problem: Automated diagnosis of Tetralogy of Fallot and postoperative risk stratification from echocardiography
42241733.patient_population: 1,986 participants (1,018 healthy controls, 480 TOF mimics, 488 TOF patients) from four centres
42241733.model_description: End-to-end multimodal deep learning system (DynaTOF) that classifies echocardiographic views, localizes key cardiac diameters, diagnoses TOF from video and diameter features, predicts postoperative abnormality dynamics over time, and stratifies postoperative risk.
42241733.headline_result: Diagnostic accuracy 0.910, AUC 0.989; postoperative prediction R2=0.852; risk-stratification AUC 0.904
42241733.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and validation study

42242890.exclusion_reason: retinal fundus photography and OCT-based oculomics for pathologic myopia; excluded non-radiologic imaging modality
